profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker DT, with SEC CIK 0001773383. Its website describes it as an observability company built for the age of AI, offering observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, and describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader. The site says the platform is meant to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and turn data into decisions and autonomous actions.

The site states that the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management, a view it attributes to Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC. A customer quotation on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The company's recorded law exposure is in Massachusetts, with a count of 176.
